info.description: Read-only original receipt scoped to authenticated tenant/store/device/operator. No implicit retry. Existing production permission and approved-device checks apply; historical reads are independent of active license. Result repeated is false in the stored original receipt.

get.description: Additional execution receipts retain original input and result after later transitions. recipe_state uses independent revision; materials have no revision. See component schemas. All requests and results are scoped to original company/store/device/operator. Stage plan and progress use original immutable event receipts; revisions are stage revisions, not order revisions. Loss declaration receipts remain recorded after a void; all quantities and immutable loss/result references are checked. No stock writes.
